Author: Weslley08
Name: Wallpaper Engine PRO
Description: Shows the wallpaper playing on your primary monitor in Wallpaper Engine, on a Ulanzi key.
Detail: Wallpaper Engine PRO reads the current wallpaper of the primary monitor from Wallpaper Engine and shows its name on a key. Press the key to refresh it. Setup: open the inspector and enter the full path to wallpaper64.exe in your Wallpaper Engine folder. Wallpaper Engine must be running. This version shows the name only, not a preview image.

Actions.Name: Current Wallpaper
Actions.Tooltip: Show the wallpaper playing on the primary monitor. Press to refresh.
